look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Inspect the small five-petaled white flowers with numerous stamens and pointed green sepals, then check divided basal leaves and later the bristly round fruit cluster of hooked styles.
taxonomy_notes: Accepted Geum canadense Jacq. in POWO. Similar white-flowered Geum species require leaf and fruit checks; a single flower is provisional recognition only.

project_inclusion.notes: County-level native-range certification deferred; no native-only metric inclusion.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect branching perennial forb, often in woodland shade or disturbed edges.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Basal leaves pinnately divided, with larger terminal segment; alternate stem leaves become less divided upwards and have toothed margins.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Small five-petaled white flowers, green pointed sepals between petals, numerous stamens.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Globose head of achenes with persistent hooked styles; this mature feature is diagnostic and needs macro photography.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Hairy to sparsely hairy branching stems; check stipules and petioles.

confused_with: Geum laciniatum (white flowers; petal/sepals, basal leaves and fruit comparison)
comparisons.key_distinctions: Check petals relative to sepals, basal leaf architecture and mature hooked styles.

diagnostic_image_needs: needs_photo: basal divided leaf and stipules
needs_photo: mature fruit with hooked styles, macro and scale
